# monotaur_label (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur label by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_label" "production" {
  id = "01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the label to look up.

### Read-Only

- `calendar_event_ids` (List of String) IDs of calendar events associated with this label.
- `color` (String) Hex colour code for the label (e.g. `#FF5733`).
- `component_ids` (List of String) IDs of components associated with this label.
- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the label was created.
- `icon` (String) Icon identifier for the label.
- `monitor_ids` (List of String) IDs of monitors associated with this label.
- `name` (String) The machine-readable name of the label.
- `text` (String) The display text of the label.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the label was last updated.
- `value` (String) The value of the label.
